title: Warm Middle Eastern Almond Knafeh
description: A herbal and juicy Middle Eastern dish featuring almond butter and nuka-pickle, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly brunch
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, mix together the almond butter, nuka-pickle, granulated sugar, rose water, and orange blossom water
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces
Place a piece of phyllo dough in a baking dish and brush it with melted butter
Spread a quarter of the almond butter mixture on top of the phyllo dough
Repeat the layers three more times, ending with a layer of phyllo dough on top
Brush the top layer of phyllo dough with melted butter and sprinkle with chopped pistachios
Bake the knafeh for 35 minutes, or until golden brown
Remove the knafeh from the oven and sprinkle with dried mint
Let the knafeh cool for 10 minutes before serving
Refrigerate and consume within 1 week — this preparation is not shelf-stable without an approved acid level and canning process.

Refrigerator pickle only: store in the fridge and consume within 1 week. For shelf-stable canning, add at least 2 tablespoons of vinegar (5% acidity) per cup of brine and follow a tested water-bath process.
